tips.text: Switch to Pow-Pow when an enemy gets close; its attack speed ramps up the longer you keep hitting.
Poke with Fishbones rockets on minions near the enemy. The splash hits champions without pulling minion aggro onto you.
Watch your mana. Every Fishbones rocket costs mana, so switch to Pow-Pow when you don't need the range.
Open trades from long range with Zap!, which leaves them slowed so you can follow up or walk away.
Line up clear of minions, since they take the hit instead when they are first in line for Zap!
Throw Flame Chompers! at your feet when someone dives you, rooting whoever steps on them.
Don't waste Flame Chompers! early, since it's your main escape on a long cooldown.
Fire Super Mega Death Rocket! from far away, since it hits harder the farther it travels and more against low-health enemies.
Take the last hit on a kill to trigger Get Excited! The burst of speed lets you chase or run.
Stay at the edge of a fight and poke until it is safe. Jinx is fragile, so don't run in and unload.

combos.name: Rev'd up rocket swap
combos.when: When you want a strong opening rocket hit after ramping up the minigun in a trade or fight.
combos.text: Ramp up Pow-Pow with a few attacks, then swap to Fishbones. Only the first rocket attack after the swap keeps the Rev'd up attack speed.

tips.text: Hit Aphelios with Zap! when he steps up to trade; it slows him and shows where he is so you can follow with rockets.
Drop Flame Chompers! at your feet when he walks in; if he steps on one he is rooted.
Switch to the rocket launcher with Switcheroo! to outrange him and poke while his weapons are still in the wrong order.
Fire Super Mega Death Rocket! from far away at a hurt Aphelios; it hits harder the farther it flies.

comboRefs.note: Ramping the minigun then swapping to rockets gives a strong opening hit in a trade against Aphelios.

tips.text: Poke Ashe with Fishbones rockets from long range. She has to walk into your range to trade back.
When Ashe closes in, root her by throwing down Flame Chompers!
Slow and reveal Ashe when she steps up to trade by firing Zap!
Stay near your team and away from open lanes when Enchanted Crystal Arrow is ready. One hit from it can stun you and get you killed.
Watch for Volley and step out of the cone. It slows you and Ashe's team can chase you down.
Dodge Sear; without a stun Brand's combo is hard to finish. Stay behind minions, since the fireball ends on the first unit it hits.
Walk sideways after Pillar of Flame is cast; it has a delay, so you can leave before it erupts.
Poke Brand with rockets from long range and use Zap! to slow him when he steps up.
Keep Flame Chompers! for when Brand steps in to hit you; the root leaves him stuck and easy to hit.
Don't stand next to your support or minions when Brand is near; Conflagration spreads between them and sets you ablaze.
Stay out of Caitlyn's reach. Her range is long, so trade with Zap! only when she steps up to push, and then retreat.
Use Fishbones to match Caitlyn's range, and switch to the minigun when she closes in.
Look for Yordle Snap Trap before you step into brush or onto unwarded ground. Being rooted lets Caitlyn hit you hard.
Stay behind minions when Caitlyn uses Piltover Peacemaker, since it hits less hard on later targets.
Put Flame Chompers where Caitlyn will dash or stand when she uses 90 Caliber Net. It roots her if she steps on one.
Zap! slows Caitlyn when she tries to walk up and trap you, giving you time to move away.
Stay out of Cassiopeia's Noxious Blast range. Sidestep it, because it lands after a short delay.
Throw Flame Chompers at your feet when Cassiopeia walks in on you. They root her and she can't dodge.
Turn away from Cassiopeia as she casts Petrifying Gaze, so you are slowed instead of stunned.
Use Zap! from long range to slow and poke Cassiopeia, since she has to come close to fight you.
Stay out of Phosphorus Bomb range and do not stand in brush; it reveals anyone it hits.
Hit Corki with Zap! when he walks up; the slow makes him easy to follow up on.
Rockets from Switcheroo! outrange Corki's Gatling Gun, so poke him from afar and switch to the minigun if he closes in.
Place Flame Chompers where Corki lands after Valkyrie; he is exposed then, so jump on him.
Hiding behind minions does not stop Missile Barrage, since it splashes. Stay out of its line.
Make Draven drop his Spinning Axe by firing Zap! at its landing spot.
Poke Draven with rockets from long range while the minigun is not ramped up. Do not stand where he can reach you with Blood Rush.
Place Flame Chompers on the path where Draven chases you or catches axes. He will be rooted if he steps on one.
Stand Aside knocks you back and slows you. Stay out of its line, because it is blocked by the first target it meets.
Stay out of Whirling Death's line when you are low on health, because it can execute you.
Hit Ezreal with Zap! when he walks up to poke; it slows him and makes him easy to hit again.
Keep minions between you and Ezreal; Mystic Shot stops at the first enemy it hits.
Place Flame Chompers! where Ezreal will jump or retreat, so he can't escape easily after using Arcane Shift.
Ezreal is fragile, so use rockets from Switcheroo! to poke him and force him back.
Ezreal's Trueshot Barrage can hit you from anywhere on the map, so stay near your team when he is at level 6.
Keep Flame Chompers! ready for when Hwei or an ally dives you; the root gives you time to back away or finish the fight.
Sidestep Hwei's slow lightning and fireball. Hwei has to guess where you will be, so keep moving between auto attacks.
Poke Hwei with Zap! from long range; it hits the first enemy and slows him, which makes him easy to follow up on.
Rush Hwei right after he casts a Torment spell; he is open to being hit then.
Don't stand still alone in lane, because Severing Bolt from Hwei's Subject: Disaster hurts more against an isolated target.

comboRefs.note: Ramped-up rocket opener gives Jinx burst to punish Hwei when he walks up to trade.

tips.text: Stay out of Jhin's line when his Deadly Flourish is ready. Once your minions or ally have hit you, it roots you.
Keep Flame Chompers ready for when Jhin jumps on you. They root him if he steps on one, so you can punish him.
Use Zap! on Jhin to slow him when he walks up to trade.
Walk around bushes and choke points with care. Jhin hides traps there, and they slow you and reveal you.
Jump on Jhin when he is out of shots. He can't attack while he reloads.
Poke Kai'Sa with Fishbones rockets and Zap! from long range, since she has to walk up to you.
Keep Flame Chompers! for when Kai'Sa dashes in with Killer Instinct; a root there can turn the fight.
Zap! Kai'Sa when she uses Supercharge to close in; the slow cuts off her run at you.
Stand away from your own minions' line of fire; Icathian Rain only needs a nearby enemy, so Kai'Sa can burst you if you are close.
Stay near your support. Kai'Sa's Plasma stacks faster with allies' stuns and roots, and she can pick you off alone.
Aim Zap! at Kalista when she lunges in to trade; it slows her, and her mobility depends on attacking.
Set Flame Chompers! between you and Kalista when she closes in, so she is rooted if she steps on one.
Use the rocket launcher from Switcheroo! to poke Kalista from long range, then switch to the minigun when she gets close.
Keep Flame Chompers! for when Kalista jumps on you, since it is your main way to get away.
Fire Super Mega Death Rocket! from far away at a hurt Kalista, since it hits harder with distance and missing health.
Stay out of Lay Waste range and don't stand next to a minion that could hide you; being the only target makes it hit much harder.
Walk around Wall of Pain rather than through it; crossing it slows you and lowers your Magic Resist.
Hit Karthus with Zap! from long range; it slows him and he has no dash to escape.
Drop Flame Chompers! on Karthus when he walks up with Defile; he is rooted and can't dodge Lay Waste.
After you kill Karthus, step away from his body; he can still cast spells for a few seconds.
Keep your health high from level 6; Requiem hits you from anywhere on the map, so go back to heal before you get low.
Kog'Maw can't escape, so look for your team to gank him. Stay near your support to punish him when he steps up.
When Kog'Maw walks up to trade, step back from his Void Ooze after you hit him with Zap!
Kog'Maw can't dodge your attacks once he is rooted, so throw down Flame Chompers!
Step out of the way of Living Artillery when it lands. Stay away from Void Ooze, because it makes the artillery easier to hit.
Kill Kog'Maw and then run away from his Icathian Surprise, since it explodes after he dies.
While he lacks Bio-Arcane Barrage, poke him from long range with rockets, and switch to the minigun if he closes in using Switcheroo!
Keep Flame Chompers! for when Lucian dashes in or you are caught; he is rooted in place and has to stop trading.
Poke with Zap! when Lucian steps up to last-hit; it slows him and makes it hard for him to start a trade.
Use the long range of Fishbones to stay out of his reach and hit him with rockets before he can engage.
Switch to Pow-Pow when Lucian gets close so you can ramp up attack speed during a trade.
Lucian has strong burst but little sustained damage, so stay healthy and fight him once his abilities are on cooldown.
When you fire Super Mega Death Rocket! from far away at a low-health Lucian, it hits hard.
Stay out of Lux's Light Binding range. Keep minions in front of you so they absorb it.
Hold Flame Chompers for when Lux walks up to trade or dives you. They root her and keep her away.
Poke Lux from long range with rocket attacks from Switcheroo! and Zap!, since she has little health early on.
Step out of Lucent Singularity before it detonates; if you stay in, you stay slowed.
When Lux fires Final Spark, a red line shows first; move sideways to dodge it.
Poke Miss Fortune with rockets from Switcheroo! while she last-hits; your extra range lets you hit her first.
Hit Miss Fortune with Zap! to break her Strut Move Speed and slow her so she can't close the gap.
Stay away from minions that line up with you, because Double Up bounces from a minion onto you.
Place Flame Chompers! between you and Miss Fortune before she engages; if she steps on one she is rooted.
Do not stand still near Miss Fortune at level 6, because Bullet Time hurts; keep Flame Chompers! ready.
Hit Nilah with Zap! as she closes in; it slows her and reveals her, which gives you room to back off.
Throw Flame Chompers! in her path; if she steps on one she is rooted and can't dash away.
Poke with rockets from long range, then switch to the minigun with Switcheroo! once she is on top of you.
Don't trade basic attacks while Jubilant Veil is up, since she dodges them.
Fire Super Mega Death Rocket! from far away at a hurt Nilah; it hits harder with distance and missing health.
Keep Zap! ready for when Samira dashes in; it slows her and can break up her approach.
Place Flame Chompers! on her path before she jumps in, so that if she steps on one she is rooted and you get time to fight back.
Stay at long range with the rocket launcher and poke her. Switch to the minigun once she reaches you.
Fire Super Mega Death Rocket! from far away at a low-health Samira, since it hits hardest after a long flight and adds damage for missing health.
Stay out of Last Embrace's line; if the enemy hits you, you're rooted and can't dodge what follows. Stand behind minions to block it.
Poke Senna with Fishbones rockets from long range; she has to walk up to hit you, and the splash can hit her and her partner.
Slow Senna with Zap! when she steps forward to attack, then back off or trade while she can't close the gap.
Throw Flame Chompers! at your feet or in the path where an enemy will step if they jump on you; it roots them.
Switch to the minigun when the enemy gets close, since it ramps up attack speed in a fight.
Wait for Sivir to use Spell Shield, then land Zap! or Flame Chompers!; faking an ability can bait it.
Dodge Boomerang Blade; it costs a lot of mana. If it hits you going out, step out of its path on the way back.
Use rocket attacks to poke from long range. Sivir pushes hard, so keep the wave from crashing into your turret.
Place Flame Chompers! where Sivir will walk to dodge, so she is rooted when she misses her dash back.
Zap! slows Sivir, so follow up with attacks; her Ricochet bounces hurt near minions.
Smolder is weak early, so poke him with Fishbones rockets off minions and punish him before he stacks up.
Hit Smolder with Zap! from long range; it slows him, so he has a hard time reaching you or escaping.
Throw Flame Chompers! in his path when he dives; if one roots him, he cannot use Flap, Flap, Flap to leave.
Stay spread from your support, since Super Scorcher Breath and Achooo! hit several enemies at once.
Switch to the minigun when he gets close. Rocket range is lost, but ramped-up attacks win a close fight.

comboRefs.note: Opening rocket hit after minigun ramp-up can punish Smolder when he steps in to trade.

tips.text: Switch to rockets to poke Tristana. Her range is shorter early, but it grows as she levels.
Once Tristana lands from Rocket Jump, throw down Flame Chompers!
When Tristana jumps in, slow her with Zap!
Stand away from your minions. Explosive Charge hurts everything around its target.
When Tristana turns on Rapid Fire, back away until it ends. Fight again once it runs out.
Stay far from Tristana when she has Buster Shot. It stuns and knocks you back.
Poke Twitch with Switcheroo! rockets from range, since he is fragile.
When Twitch goes invisible with Ambush, step back from your support and keep Flame Chompers! ready for his approach.
Hit Twitch with Zap! when he is invisible; it reveals him and slows him so your team can focus him.
Leave Venom Cask clouds quickly. Staying in them adds Deadly Venom stacks that Contaminate then uses to hit hard.
Switch to the minigun in Switcheroo! when Twitch closes in, so you get Attack Speed for the close fight.
Varus is slowed while charging Piercing Arrow, so hit him with Zap!
When Varus dives on you, throw down Flame Chompers! to root him and escape.
Stay out of the line of Chain of Corruption and keep away from your teammates. It spreads to any enemy champion who stays close to the rooted one.
Step out of Hail of Arrows quickly. It slows you and cuts your healing.
Poke Varus with rockets while he stays back, swapping to them with Switcheroo!
Keep your distance and poke Vayne with the rockets of Switcheroo! She needs to get close to trade well.
Where Vayne will walk or Tumble in, a root lets you survive, so lay down Flame Chompers!
Stay away from walls. Condemn into terrain stuns you and hurts a lot.
When Vayne walks up, slow her with Zap! It is your best tool to stop her closing in.
Use Super Mega Death Rocket! from far away on a low-health Vayne; it hits hardest after a long flight.
Keep your distance from Veigar's cage. If you walk into its edge you are stunned, so stay outside it or inside it.
Move as soon as you see Dark Matter's marker, because it lands after a short delay. Don't stand still while you attack.
Zap! Veigar to slow him and keep him away from you. Land it when he tries to place a cage on you.
Put Flame Chompers! between you and Veigar when he walks up. If he steps on one he is rooted, and you can hit him while he is fragile.
Use the rocket launcher from Switcheroo! to hit Veigar from long range. He is fragile, so poke him whenever his spells are on cooldown.
Fire Zap! at Xayah when she walks up to last-hit; it slows her and she has a hard time answering.
Hold Flame Chompers! for when Xayah or her partner dives you; being rooted in place makes them easy to kill.
Poke Xayah with Switcheroo! rockets for the extra range, and stay out of her short Double Daggers range.
Do not stand in the feathers she leaves on the ground; Bladecaller roots enemies hit by several of them.
Wait until Xayah lands from Featherstorm before you fire Super Mega Death Rocket!
Hold Zap! until Yasuo drops Wind Wall, then fire it; the wall blocks your shots while it is up.
Throw Flame Chompers! at your feet when Yasuo dashes in; if he is rooted, he cannot reach you.
Switch to the minigun when Yasuo gets close, and keep poking him with rockets while he is far away.
Stay back from your minions when Yasuo has dash targets. Sweeping Blade lets him close in quickly.
Step aside when Yasuo's whirlwind from Steel Tempest comes at you; being knocked up lets him follow with Last Breath.
Hold Flame Chompers! for when Yunara dashes or walks in on you; she is rooted and can't get away from your follow-up.
Use rockets from Switcheroo! to poke Yunara from long range, then switch to the minigun if she closes in.
Zap! her when she steps up to trade; the slow stops her from reaching you and makes her easy to hit.
Stay back when Yunara casts Transcend One's Self. Her attacks spread to nearby enemies and her beam hurts.
Fire Super Mega Death Rocket! from far away at a weakened Yunara, since it hits harder the farther it flies.
Hit Zeri with Zap! when she dashes or walks up; it slows her and makes her easy to hit.
Place Flame Chompers! where Zeri will dash or step to trade; if she touches one she is rooted and takes damage.
Switch to Switcheroo! rockets to outrange Zeri's pokes, and use minigun ramp-up only when she is close.
Save Super Mega Death Rocket! for a long shot after Zeri is slowed, since she is fragile and fast.
Do not step on Ziggs' mines. Hexplosive Minefield slows you and sets up his other spells.
When Ziggs walks up for a last-hit, hit him with Zap! to slow and reveal him.
Use Fishbones rockets to hit Ziggs from range. He has to stand close to use most of his spells.
Go at Ziggs right after he uses Bouncing Bomb or Satchel Charge. Both have long cooldowns.
When Ziggs dives or runs at you, root him with Flame Chompers!
